component.name: OpenFive
component.summary: Play The Famous Five: Treasure Island from your own CD

description.p: OpenFive is an open-source reimplementation of the engine of the 1999 adventure game The Famous Five: Treasure Island (5 Freunde auf Schatzsuche). It plays the original adventure natively, in a window or fullscreen.
OpenFive contains no code, graphics, text, speech or music from the original game. You need your own copy of the game CD, English or German, or a disc image of it.
